lines.en: Feasting on flesh as it moves
I nudge the meat wall aside and push on.

lines.zh: 嘴巴贴在血肉上，一路吸过去。
lines.en: Mouth pressed to flesh, I sip my way along.

lines.zh: 身体一屈一伸，像在水里。
lines.en: Body curling and stretching, as if in water.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根血管转了一圈。
lines.en: I coil once around a vein.

lines.zh: 血水被我搅出一圈红涡。
lines.en: I churn the blood into a red swirl.

lines.zh: 我钻进肉褶里，只剩尾巴。
lines.en: I burrow into a fold, only my tail showing.
I hang from the flesh wall, swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴着血肉，我歇一歇。
lines.en: Sucker against the flesh, I rest.

lines.zh: 我张合着嘴，试了试水温。
lines.en: I open and close my mouth, testing the blood's warmth.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块烂肉。
lines.en: I lie still as a lump of rotten meat.

lines.zh: 我没有眼，只认你手腕的脉。
lines.en: I have no eyes; I know your pulse at the wrist.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在肉里，看着。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I watch from inside the flesh.
I raise my round mouth from the blood.
I watch the pulse at your wrist.
You back away, and I follow an inch.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里找血的味道。
lines.en: In your shadow, I hunt the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 肉壁挤过来，我被压扁了半截。
lines.en: The flesh wall squeezes and flattens half of me.

lines.zh: 吸不进血，我的身子瘪下去。
lines.en: Blood won't come, and my body deflates.
The wound seems to consume me.

lines.zh: 诱人血肉中蠕动，腐臭之歌响起。
lines.en: Sway in decay, reek of corruption.

lines.zh: 游弋于腐肉间，贪婪的咕哝。
lines.en: Gulp in the rot, greedy moan.

lines.zh: 深入血肉深处，咀嚼血液之味。
lines.en: Dive into flesh, taste the blood.

lines.zh: 猎物在肉中闪烁，饥渴的低语。
lines.en: Prey glows in flesh, thirsty whisper.

lines.zh: 靠近腐肉边缘，嘶嘶声逼近。
lines.en: Near the flesh's edge, hiss near.

lines.zh: 游动在死亡之地，低吟求食。
lines.en: Swim in death, low hunger call.

lines.zh: 在血肉中漂浮，微光闪烁。
在腐肉中蜿蜒，嘶嘶声回应。
在血肉中潜行，低语缠绕。
撞击血肉边界，回响冲击。
碰撞肉壁，发出沉闷声响。
在血肉中碰撞，发出低沉声音。
肉壁之间来回碰撞，声音回荡。
撞向肉壁，声音在血肉中震响。
在肉壁之间碰撞，回声震荡。
在血肉中相撞，发出闷响。
碰撞肉壁，声音在深处回响。
靠近同类，发出求偶嘶嘶声。
在腐肉中求偶，低语缠绵。
在血肉中交配，微光闪烁。
在腐肉中求偶，低吟不息。
在血肉深处求爱，微光闪烁。
肉蛭从血肉中蠕动出来。
lines.en: The Flesh Lamprey wriggles out of the flesh.

lines.zh: 我从血肉里钻出来，像游泳。
lines.en: I swim out through flesh and blood.
The Flesh Lamprey bites your arm.
The Flesh Lamprey slides into your skin.
The Flesh Lamprey starts to leech.
The Flesh Lamprey swims towards the wound.

lines.zh: 你的伤口渗进血水，我尝到了。
lines.en: Your wound bleeds into the water, and I taste it.
The Flesh Lamprey moves in the blood.

lines.zh: 圆嘴一缩，我贴向你的小腿。
lines.en: My round mouth contracts; I press toward your calf.
The Flesh Lamprey begins to feed.
The Flesh Lamprey acquires the target.
Swimming through flesh is easier than water.
It uses its tentacles to wrap around you.
The Flesh Lamprey swims in the blood.
The Flesh Lamprey clings to you.
It starts to leech your blood.
The Flesh Lamprey searches for blood.
Its sound is like flowing water.
The Flesh Lamprey tries to bite you.
In flesh I swim as if in water.

lines.zh: 吸盘咬住，血往我肚里走。
lines.en: The sucker locks on and blood flows into me.

lines.zh: 圆嘴贴上你的皮肤，吸住了！
lines.en: My round mouth seals onto your skin and pulls!
Hanging upside down, I bite your neck!

lines.zh: 血肉就是水，我游得很快。
lines.en: Flesh is water — I swim it fast.

lines.zh: 血肉里游出来的，是血不是水。
lines.en: I swim out of flesh — that's blood, not water.
In this endless sea of blood.

lines.zh: 血池冒了个泡，我浮出来。
lines.en: The blood pool bubbles, and I surface.
Someone fished me out of here.

lines.zh: 震波把肉壁炸开，我翻出去。
lines.en: The blast tears the flesh wall open and flings me out.

lines.zh: 箭头穿过我，带出一串血珠。
lines.en: The arrowhead passes through, trailing beads of blood.

lines.zh: 血肉里没有饥饿，只有空。
lines.en: In flesh there's no hunger, only emptiness.

lines.zh: 电在血水里跳，我全身都在抽。
lines.en: The current skips through the blood and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 这里没有血肉，我只能干瘪。
lines.en: There is no flesh here; I can only wither.
